title: Explicit Robin Green's Functions, Resonance Spectra, and Impedance Recovery on Annuli and Spherical Shells
summary: This paper constructs explicit closed-form Green's functions for the Helmholtz equation on annular and spherical-shell domains with two independent Robin impedances on the inner and outer boundaries. Graf's and the hyperspherical addition theorems reduce each angular mode to an explicit $2\times2$ linear system, and the resonance spectrum is governed by a characteristic determinant bilinear in the two impedances.
